fact: In 2025 the ANTIC CIRT recorded 17,500 complaints (FCFA 5.8 billion loss) and tracked 21,280 compromised machines, and ANTIC said firms hit by cybercrime must report it to ANTIC.
title: Prosper PAGOU (ANTIC) : « En 2025, nous avons enregistré 17 500 plaintes pour un préjudice de 5,8 milliards de FCFA »
